title: 한국도로공사법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Designation of Specialized Institutions)
(1) Institutions that may be designated as specialized institutions pursuant to Article 16-3 (4) of the Korea Expressway Corporation Act shall be as follows:
1. An accounting corporation qualified as an auditor under Article 3 of the Act on External Audit of Stock Companies;
2. Among government-funded research institutes established under the Act on the Establishment, Operation and Fostering of Government-Funded Research Institutes, etc., a research institute related to transportation.
(2) Where necessary to enhance objectivity in calculating and evaluating public service costs, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport may designate two or more institutions under paragraph (1) to jointly perform such duties. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
